section_summary.extract_value: This section reports a single path analysis testing how body image-related cognitive fusion (CFQ_BI) and body appreciation (BAS_2) mediate the relationship between body image discrepancy (BID) and disordered eating (EDE_Q), controlling for BMI. The final model (Figure 1) explained 13% of CFQ_BI variance, 23% of BAS_2 variance, and 67% of EDE_Q variance; all reported path coefficients were significant and BMI had only a small direct effect on EDE_Q. No explicit labels like 'Study 1' or multiple separate studies/subsamples are mentioned in this section.
